title: The Future of Sustainable Tech: Eco-Friendly Gadgets
subtitle: How technology is evolving to save the planet.
author: TechVanguard
content:
Sustainability in consumer tech is shifting from marketing to measurable impact. The most meaningful progress is in materials and energy: modern LFP battery packs withstand more charge cycles, plant‑based polymers cut plastic use, and occupancy‑aware, weather‑integrated thermostats lower consumption without sacrificing comfort.

Materials

Bioplastics and recycled aluminum reduce the footprint without compromising durability. Repairability matters too—choose products with accessible screws and clear part availability.

Energy

Smarter charging and efficient standby reduce wasted power. Devices that survive more cycles and avoid vampire draw have outsized environmental benefits.
